children: IES Holdings reported fiscal 2026 revenue up 33% and operating income up 58% year over year. Its board authorized an additional $350M for share repurchases on November 19.
Strong year-over-year growth supports the earnings story; the release provides no consolidated dollar totals here.
Expands planned capital returns, though the authorization does not guarantee the company will use the full amount.
Housing weakness and lower segment earnings contrast with growth elsewhere; income was $103.8M in FY2025.
DBM added $2.6B backlog, excluded at year-end
The acquisition adds a substantial future-work pipeline, but it was not included in reported September 30 backlog.

This is a mid-cycle update showing strong growth in several segments alongside continued weakness in Residential, with DBM Global adding new scale. The next catalyst is fiscal 2027 execution, including whether organic growth and cash generation support debt repayment after the acquisition.
